pageCache.pageTitle: Headteacher’s Welcome – St John's Wallingford Primary School
pageCache.text:
Headteacher’s Welcome
On behalf of our entire school team, I would like to extend a very warm welcome to St. John’s Primary School.
Nestled in the heart of the beautiful and historic town of Wallingford, our one-form entry school is proud to be part of the local community and enjoys a strong reputation within it. We offer a warm and caring atmosphere and are determined that our school is a safe and stimulating environment to grow, learn and work. We pride ourselves on ensuring that all children at St John’s feel nurtured, whilst striving for the highest standards of achievement. We promote positive values in all we do, focusing on our core values of Perseverance, Ambition, Curiosity and Kindness and showing that we are Ready, Respectful and Safe in all aspects of school life.
All members of our school community are committed to ensure that St John’s pupils leave us well-prepared for the next stage of their education, enjoying the challenges that learning brings and are well on their way to becoming successful life-long learners, having experienced an exciting and engaging primary school experience.
Our ambitious and creative curriculum is enriched by a range of additional experiences, such as Forest School for KS1 and after school clubs. We plan trips, themed days and visitors to school throughout the year to bring our curriculum subjects to life.
Pupil wellbeing is a high priority at St John’s; pupils are explicitly taught emotional literacy skills and the school provides individual support when it is needed.
St John’s is part of the OPEN Umbrella Trust, a collaborative partnership of four forward-thinking primary schools in South Oxfordshire, working together to provide an excellent education for all of our pupils.
We have a talented and dedicated staff team who are keen to work in partnership with parents to support children’s learning and wider development. We are also supported by our hard-working PTFA who organise social events for children and families and raise valuable funds for projects within the school.
We would be delighted to welcome you to our school and would welcome you to book a visit through our school office.
Feedback about our school
“Staff go the extra mile to ensure that pupils are happy, safe and successful. Leaders have high expectations. They continually reflect on how they can improve the experience of pupils in this welcoming and nurturing environment.”
“A massive thank you to all the staff at the school for making my son’s education so varied, interesting, exciting, creative and captivating…..Thank you for all the commitment and time you give to make all this magic happen!”
Parent Survey, July 2022

pageCache.pageTitle: Breakfast/After School Club – St John's Wallingford Primary School
pageCache.text:
We are delighted to offer our parents school-based wraparound care through our Breakfast Club and JACS, our after-school care scheme. Both are open to children who attend our school.
Both facilities are open term-time only.
Breakfast Club runs 7:45am – 8:45am (£7.15 per session)
JACS After School Club runs 3:15pm – 5:30pm Mon-Thurs and 3:15pm – 5:00pm on Fri (£15.00 per session)
To register your child and to request a contract, or if you would like to make an ad-hoc booking for a single session, please contact the school office or email jacsafterschoolclub@st-johns.oxon.sch.uk.

pageCache.pageTitle: School Starters – St John's Wallingford Primary School
pageCache.text:
School Starters
We are delighted to welcome applications for places at St. John’s. Most of our school places are taken by children who live in the local area, but we have also some children who travel in from further. It is really important to visit schools, so that you feel you have the right “fit” for your child and family.
For children starting school in September 2026:
We would like to invite parents of children born between 1st September, 2021 and 31st August, 2022 (inclusive) to apply for a school place for September 2026 via the Oxfordshire County Council website. Oxfordshire County Council have lots of helpful information on their website, including a Starting School Guide https://www.oxfordshire.gov.uk/schools/apply-school-place/reception-applications.
The primary school admissions process will open on 4th November, 2025 with an applications deadline of 15th January, 2024. There is a final date to confirm a change of address of 30th January, 2026. The national offer day, where all families find out which school has been offered, is 16th April,2026.
We do recommend that you fill all preferences on your application for a school place.
We look forward to welcoming you to our school.

pageCache.pageTitle: Curriculum Information – St John's Wallingford Primary School
pageCache.text:
Curriculum Statement 2023
At the beginning of each term, teachers will write to you about the work that is planned, so that you can support your child. Regular school newsletters are sent out too.
Written reports of your child’s progress are sent home annually, and there are opportunities for you to meet with teachers at parents’ evenings. Your child’s teacher should always be your first point of contact about his or her progress and welfare, followed by a meeting with the Headteacher, if necessary.
At St John’s, your children will be set challenging work that is appropriate to their abilities, and we expect high standards of behaviour and achievement. We believe that praise and recognition are very important to help children succeed, and will encourage and celebrate good effort at every opportunity.
We try to draw on all resources at our disposal in order to achieve our learning objectives and recognise the importance of effective home/school links in contributing to your child’s educational development.
We expect, and value, the assistance and support of parents in this and encourage all families to support our Vision and Values.
Termly topic plans for each class can be found on the individual class pages, under the “Curriculum” button.
Reading Schemes and Phonics
For information about our reading and phonics schemes, please click on our English or Phonics buttons above.
For more information about our curriculum please contact us directly.

pageCache.text:
Outdoor Woodland Learning Sessions (OWLS)
We are lucky to have a dedicated woodland area, adjacent to our school field, that we use for outdoor learning. Children in all year groups have the opportunity to explore this natural environment: learning about its flora and fauna; enjoying developing natural arts, crafts and skills, and participating in imaginative and sensory learning activities.

pageCache.text:
Welcome to Foundation Stage
A very warm welcome awaits in our Reception class. This is the beginning of a wonderful learning adventure. In our classroom, children explore, play, imagine and discover new things every day. Reception is all about building confidence, making friends and developing a love of learning through fun, hands-on experiences. Our curriculum is full of exciting activities that help each child grow and shine.Take a look at the Class Curriculum section on our webpage to see what we’ll be enjoying throughout the year.

Welcome to Year 1
Welcome to Year 1! This year is an exciting step as the children move from Foundation Stage into more structured learning, while still enjoying plenty of play and exploration. Our classroom is a place where curiosity grows, confidence builds and new skills are discovered every day. The Year 1 curriculum is full of fun topics, practical activities and opportunities to learn together helping us to become increasingly independent learners.Have a look at the Class Curriculum section to see all the wonderful learning adventures ahead.
